name: Stitch Prism ID model (Stitch.PrismId)
statement: Stitch's Prism ID model at the commit Verdant Engine v2.22.4 pins in identity/stitch.lock: devices of one id, signed actions bound to an audience, freshness, linking and revocation. Every authorization decision of a Prism ID session is taken by it. Cited by the agent's signed session with Verdant Studio (REQ-AGENT-INTERFACE).
